profileLabel: Mildly left economics; slightly restrictive on speech and media; pro-transparency
summary: Quezon 4th District representative with about 214 principal-authored bills. Authored a right-to-information act, an independent commission on infrastructure anomalies, an anti-dynasty ban and Comelec strengthening, alongside penalties for false internet content, MTRCB streaming regulation, deepfake likeness rights, a no-call registry, jail rehabilitation training, higher service incentive leave and several tax and system-loss relief bills.
caveat: Civil-liberties score is sensitive to how the false-content and streaming-regulation bills are written; only titles were reviewed. Bill-based; no votes.

economic.label: Center-left
economic.rationale: Increased service incentive leave (-2) and a ban on passing system-loss costs to consumers (-1); tax amnesty, fuel excise suspension, VAT exemption on system loss and travel-tax abolition are direction-neutral (0). Three issues.

social.label: Insufficient evidence

civil.label: Restrictive-leaning
civil.rationale: Authored penalties for publishing false internet content (-2) and bringing streaming under MTRCB (-2); deepfake likeness rights and a no-call registry (+1); skills training for detained persons (+1). Net slightly restrictive; four issues, titles only.

democratic.rationale: Authored a people's right-to-information act (+3), an independent commission on infrastructure anomalies (+2), an anti-dynasty ban (+2, common coalition bill) and Comelec manpower strengthening (+1). Bill-based, no votes reviewed.
